messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: elevated 429/503 observed for /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate (us-west-2). auto-paging oncall group.
Alice: acknowledged, joining. pulling up heatmaps and per-tenant QPS now.
Carla: embedding QPS up 3x in the last 5m, node queue lengths for gpu-pool-usw2 approaching 95%. 503s start showing where queue saturates.
Ben: KV cache hit rate collapsed to 20% for embeddings, tail latency >1s for many requests. suspect a high fanout tenant or increased batch size.
Morgan: customers pinged via support. one major customer (acct-88) reports repeated 503s. i'll collect request ids and time windows.
Alice: we need mitigations that are reversible and low-risk. list quick options pls.
Carla: quick list: a) flip feature flag to disable live-embeddings b) emergency per-tenant QPS clamp c) apply routing rule to divert huge payloads to smaller quant model d) bump soft rate-limit drop to shed burst traffic
Ben: (1) realtime-embeds is the dominant consumer right now. (2) there's evidence of very large request payloads from acct-88. (3) node-gpu-19 shows repeated SIGKILLs.
Alice: ok, plan: 1) flip feature flag for realtime-embeds 2) apply per-tenant clamp to acct-88 3) add routing rule for requests > 6k tokens -> embed-small-quant fallback. I'll sequence to minimize churn.
Alice: running: ```ffctl prod set feature.realtime-embeds false --meta "incident-mitigate-429-503"```
deploy-bot: feature.realtime-embeds disabled in prod. rollout id: r-3012-ff-01.
Carla: within 40s embeddings QPS drops ~60%, 429 rate for /v1/embeddings down by ~70%. good signal.
Morgan: support: acct-88 acknowledged improvement for some requests but still seeing intermittent 503s on generate endpoints.
Ben: generate 503s persist at ~4%. logs show worker process OOMKilled during large batched generations.
Alice: reduce global max_batch_size to 100 and put short 20m clamp for acct-88 concurrency to 3. apply both.
Alice: commands: ```cfgctl set runtime.max_batch_size 100 --env prod``` and ```quotactl clamp tenant:acct-88 --concurrency 3 --duration 20m --reason "live clamping to avoid OOMs"```
deploy-bot: runtime.max_batch_size updated; quota clamp applied to acct-88 (20m).
Carla: after changes, gen 503s dropped to 0.8% and tail latency improving. queue depth steady.
infra-bot: kube: node-gpu-19 restarted worker process 3x in last 6m, node memory pressure at 92%. scheduled node audit ticket INF-3012 created.
Jared: i'll take follow-up monitoring. keep me posted on any restart spikes. Alice, passing handoff in 15m.
Ben: collecting heap dumps and tracing for acct-88 samples, saving to /incidents/INC-3012/artifacts. recommend holding off on draining node-gpu-19 until we have dumps.
Alice: customer comms drafted. Morgan, please send interim update noting mitigations and ETA for RCA.
Morgan: on it. also adding request ids and timeline to the support cases.
Carla: telemetry snapshot checklist done: saved kvcache metrics, queue histograms, per-node OOM logs, feature-flag state, applied quotas and routes.
Ben: follow-ups: - analyze SDK patterns for retries/fanout - check if a new SDK version correlates with payload shape - validate autoscaler config for embedding workers
Alice: marking temporary mitigations: ff off, acct-88 clamp, max_batch_size lowered, route fallback for >6k tokens. Will keep ff off until postmortem and deploy window unless safe.
Jared: taking over monitoring. set alert to escalate if 503 >1% for 5m or OOM restarts >2 in 10m. adding myself to incident ticket INC-3012.
Morgan: customers updated, asked if they'd like a post-incident call. one asks for more granular logs, we'll share sanitized traces.
Alice: closing live ops thread for now. I'll add timeline and commands to INC-3012 and create a triage meeting +24h to review root cause and runbook gaps.
deploy-bot: INCIDENT recorded -> INC-3012. postmortem template created and assigned to SRE.
Alice: thanks team. handoff complete.
Jared: ack, monitoring. leaving note: if we revert ff, do it via canary to 10% first.
end of thread
